name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
description: Drive Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce from any AI agent: products, categories, orders, customers, stock and CMS pages and blocks. 21 tools, Bearer admin-token auth, per-store base URL.
instructions:
This connector uses the Magento 2 REST API (devdocs.magento.com).

**Setup**:
1. As Magento admin → **System → Integrations → Add New Integration**.
2. Name + email, then on the API tab pick scopes: at minimum Catalog (Products + Categories + Stock), Customers, Sales (Orders + Invoices + Shipments).
3. **Activate** the integration → grant access. Magento generates an **Access Token** (this is the long-lived bearer token).
4. Set:
   - `MAGENTO_BASE_URL` = your storefront base URL (e.g. `https://shop.example.com`)
   - `MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN` = the integration access token
   - Optionally `MAGENTO_STORE_VIEW` if you want a specific store view (default 'default' or use 'all')

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer ${MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN}`.

**Path prefix**: `/rest/{store_view}/V1/...`. The adapter uses `/rest/default/V1/` as default — if you need to target a different store view, replace baseUrl accordingly or pass `?storeCode=` (Magento accepts both).

**Search criteria DSL**: Magento has a unique multi-key search syntax for list endpoints:
```
?searchCriteria[filter_groups][0][filters][0][field]=status
&searchCriteria[filter_groups][0][filters][0][value]=1
&searchCriteria[filter_groups][0][filters][0][condition_type]=eq
&searchCriteria[pageSize]=20
&searchCriteria[currentPage]=1
```
It's verbose but powerful. The adapter exposes the most common filters as flat params and lets you pass arbitrary criteria via `searchCriteria_raw` for advanced cases.

**SKU as primary key**: most product endpoints use SKU (not ID) in the URL: `/V1/products/{sku}`.

**Rate limits**: not enforced by Magento core — depends on hosting. On 429 back off.

**Out of scope here**: GraphQL endpoint (separate), Inventory MSI deep features, B2B/Commerce-only features (shared catalogs, company hierarchies), sales rules editing.

**CMS pages and blocks** always go through the `all` store code (`/rest/all/V1/cmsPage`, `/rest/all/V1/cmsBlock`), Magento's admin scope, so a page written there is not silently moved to one store view. The create and update tools change the live storefront and are installed switched off; there is no delete tool.

MAGENTO_BASE_URL.label: Store address
MAGENTO_BASE_URL.help: The address of the store, without /rest or /admin.

MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Integration access token
MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Admin → System → Extensions → Integrations → Add New Integration, grant the resources, Activate: copy the Access Token.

verifyHints.401: Magento refused the token. Since 2.4.4 an integration token only works as a bearer token when Stores → Configuration → Services → OAuth → Consumer Settings → "Allow OAuth Access Tokens to be used as standalone Bearer tokens" is Yes.

tools.name: magento_list_store_views
tools.description: List the store views of the Magento / Adobe Commerce instance (id, code, name, website). A cheap read that also confirms the access token works.

tools.name: magento_search_products
tools.description: Search products with Magento's search criteria DSL. For simple filters use the flat params (sku/name/status/visibility). For complex multi-condition use searchCriteria_raw.

pageSize.description: Per page (default 20, max ~300 due to URL length).

tools.name: magento_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by SKU. Returns full attributes including custom_attributes[].

sku.description: Product SKU (URL-encode if contains special chars).

tools.name: magento_create_product
tools.description: Create a product. Required: product.sku + product.name + product.type_id + product.attribute_set_id + product.price.

product.description: {sku, name, type_id:'simple'|'configurable'|'virtual'|'bundle'|'grouped'|'downloadable', attribute_set_id:N (usually 4 for default), price, status?:1, visibility?:4, weight?, custom_attributes?:[{attribute_code,value}], extension_attributes?:{stock_item:{qty,is_in_stock}}}.

saveOptions.description: If true, save configurable options too.

tools.name: magento_update_product
tools.description: Update a product by SKU (PUT).

product.description: Partial product object — only fields to change.

tools.name: magento_delete_product
tools.description: Permanently delete a product by SKU.

tools.name: magento_update_stock
tools.description: Update inventory stock for a SKU at a source. For single-source (default 'default' source).

tools.name: magento_list_categories
tools.description: List the category tree (or below a rootCategoryId).

tools.name: magento_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders.

status.description: pending, processing, complete, closed, canceled, holded.

tools.name: magento_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order by ID with billing/shipping addresses, items[], status history.

tools.name: magento_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order (only valid in pending/processing status). Returns true on success.

tools.name: magento_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers with the same DSL.

tools.name: magento_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by ID.

tools.name: magento_search_cms_pages
tools.description: Search CMS pages (content pages such as about-us, shipping, terms) with id, identifier (URL key), title, active flag, meta data and the HTML content. Without a filter it pages through all pages. Example filter: field identifier, value %shipping%, condition_type like.

field.description: Field to filter on, e.g. identifier, title, is_active, page_id.

value.description: Filter value; with condition_type like wrap it in %, e.g. %shipping%.

tools.name: magento_get_cms_page
tools.description: Read one CMS page by its numeric id, including the full HTML content, layout and meta data.

tools.name: magento_search_cms_blocks
tools.description: Search CMS blocks (reusable content such as header, footer and homepage banners) with id, identifier, title, active flag and the HTML content. Example filter: field identifier, value %footer%, condition_type like.

field.description: Field to filter on, e.g. identifier, title, is_active, block_id.

value.description: Filter value; with condition_type like wrap it in %.

tools.name: magento_get_cms_block
tools.description: Read one CMS block by its numeric id, including the full HTML content.

tools.name: magento_create_cms_page
tools.description:
Create a CMS page. page is {"identifier": "url-key", "title": "...", "content": "

HTML

", "active": true, "page_layout": "1column", "meta_title": "...", "meta_description": "..."}. The page goes live on the storefront when active is true. Installed switched off.

page.description: The page fields, as described above. identifier and title are required.

tools.name: magento_update_cms_page
tools.description:
Change a CMS page. Read it first with magento_get_cms_page and send page with its id, identifier and title plus the fields to change, e.g. {"id": 5, "identifier": "shipping", "title": "Shipping", "content": "

...

"}. Changes are live on the storefront at once (after the page cache refreshes). Installed switched off.

page.description: The page fields: id, identifier and title always, then what changes.

tools.name: magento_create_cms_block
tools.description:
Create a CMS block. block is {"identifier": "...", "title": "...", "content": "
HTML
", "active": true}. A block only shows where a layout or widget references its identifier. Installed switched off.

block.description: The block fields. identifier and title are required.

tools.name: magento_update_cms_block
tools.description: Change a CMS block. Read it first with magento_get_cms_block and send block with its id, identifier and title plus the fields to change. Header, footer and homepage blocks change on every page that uses them. Installed switched off.

block.description: The block fields: id, identifier and title always, then what changes.
